user.title: Connect to your Harmony hub
user.description: Enter the hub address and the access token.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The hub rejected the saved token. Enter the new token.

hassio_confirm.title: Link the Harmony Editor add-on
hassio_confirm.description: The Harmony Editor add-on was found. Link it so this hub gets its configuration from the add-on? The add-on only feeds the config; this integration stays the hub's only client.

error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected by the hub.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the hub.
error.unsupported_version: The hub speaks an incompatible protocol version. Update the hub firmware or this integration so both use the same version.

abort.wrong_hub: The token belongs to a different hub.
abort.addon_linked: The Harmony Editor add-on is linked.
abort.addon_updated: The Harmony Editor add-on address was updated.
abort.no_hub: Set up a Harmony hub first, then restart the Harmony Editor add-on so it announces itself again.
abort.invalid_auth: The add-on refused the discovery token. Restart the add-on and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Harmony Editor add-on.
abort.invalid_discovery: The add-on sent an unusable discovery message.

config_invalid.title: Harmony config from the add-on was rejected
config_invalid.description: The add-on's applied config for hub {hub} failed validation here and the previous config stays active: {error}

config_rejected.title: The hub rejected the Harmony config
config_rejected.description: Hub {hub} refused the pushed config and keeps running its previous one: {error}

bundle_schema.title: Harmony add-on and integration versions do not match
bundle_schema.description: Hub {hub}: {error}. Update the Harmony Editor add-on and the Harmony integration to matching versions; the previous config stays active.

yaml_unused.title: Upload your Harmony YAML in the Harmony Editor add-on
yaml_unused.description: Integration 0.3.0 no longer reads {path} for hub {hub}. Upload that file in the Harmony Editor add-on (import YAML, then apply). The file is untouched; delete it once imported.

reload_config.name: Reload config
reload_config.description: Pull the applied config from the Harmony Editor add-on now, recompile it and push it if it changed.
